working_definition: A very small (n=9) marker co-expression subcluster from Davie et al. 2018's Figure 2K neuropeptide re-clustering, defined solely by co-expression of Mip and ITP transcripts. The 9 cells split ambiguously across four different primary (res-2.0) clusters, have no dedicated marker list or literature reference, and the report concludes this is most likely a transcriptomic co-expression artefact of the small-n subclustering exercise rather than a genuine, anatomically defined neuron population.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any adult neuron that expresses Mip (FBgn0036713).

justification: Mip/ITP is one of the authors' named groups from the re-clustering of neuropeptide-expressing cells (Figure 2K), named for co-expression of Mip and ITP. Its cells are therefore both myoinhibitory peptide neurons (FBbt:00047527) and ITP neurons (FBbt:00048313); the cluster is mapped to both as composed primarily of. Broad matches: the group is a subset of each class.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any peptidergic neuron of the adult.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Common parent of the two peptide classes; the authors name both peptides, so the cluster is mapped to both specific classes instead.

recommendation: Broad match to both FBbt:00047527 adult myoinhibitory peptide neuron and FBbt:00048313 ITP neuron.

additional_matches.fbbt_definition: Neuron that expresses Ion transport peptide. It is neurosecretory.
